questions.question: Associate the importance of the Treaty of Westphalia in shaping modern nation-states
questions.solution_html:
• Treaty of Westphalia (1648) marked the beginning of the modern nation-state system by
  • establishing state sovereignty, legal equality among states, and non-interference in internal
  • affairs, shaping international relations and political order.
questions.final_answer: affairs, shaping international relations and political order

questions.question: Recall the historical evolution of any one Indian classical dance form
questions.solution_html:
• Bharatanatyam evolved from ancient Tamil Nadu temple traditions, particularly from the
  • Devadasi system-transformed into a classical dance emphasizing rhythm, expression, and
  • spirituality, revived in the 20th century as a symbol of Indian cultural heritage-Kuchipudi is
  • a classical dance form from Andhra Pradesh combining graceful movements, expressive
  • storytelling, and rhythmic footwork rooted in ancient Sanskrit theatre traditions.
questions.final_answer: storytelling, and rhythmic footwork rooted in ancient Sanskrit theatre traditions

questions.question: Explain the role judiciary in India upholding secularism in the Constitution?
questions.solution_html:
• Judiciary safeguards secularism through judgments ensuring equality of all religions
  • banning discrimination, and limiting state support for religious practices-upholds
  • constitutional principles of freedom of religion and separation of state and faith.
questions.final_answer: constitutional principles of freedom of religion and separation of state and faith

questions.question: Discuss the significance of reservation policies in empowering Dalits
questions.solution_html:
• Reservation policies have empowered Dalits by ensuring representation in education
  • employment, and politics-aim to correct historical injustices, promote social inclusion, and
  • enhance equality within India’s democratic framework of affirmative action.
questions.final_answer: enhance equality within India’s democratic framework of affirmative action

questions.question: Explain the meaning of the word secularism
questions.solution_html:
• Secularism means separation of religion and state, ensuring religious freedom and
  • equality-promotes tolerance, protects minority rights, and maintains neutrality of the state in
  • religious matters to preserve harmony in a plural society.
questions.final_answer: religious matters to preserve harmony in a plural society

questions.question: Recall the cultural golden age of the Gupta Empire.
questions.solution_html:
• Gupta Empire’s golden age saw advances in art, literature, science, and mathematics
  • achievements included works by Kalidasa, Aryabhata’s discoveries, and flourishing
  • architecture, marking a peak in India’s classical cultural development.
questions.final_answer: architecture, marking a peak in India’s classical cultural development

questions.question: Summerise major impact of fake news on religious harmony?
questions.solution_html:
• Fake news spreads misinformation that provokes communal tensions and distrust among
  • religious groups-fuels prejudice, distorts facts, and undermines social harmony, leading to
  • polarization and potential outbreaks of violence in diverse societies.
questions.final_answer: polarization and potential outbreaks of violence in diverse societies

questions.question: Explain how the Mandir–Masjid dispute influenced party politics in India
questions.solution_html:
• Mandir–Masjid dispute reshaped Indian party politics by mobilizing religious sentiment
  • eventual destruction of Babari Masjid-intensified communal polarization, influenced electoral
  • strategies, and strengthened Hindu nationalist narratives, transforming secular political
  • discourse into identity-based competition.
questions.final_answer: discourse into identity-based competition

questions.question: Differentiate between Nehruvian and Gandhian understanding on secularism
questions.solution_html:
• Nehruvian secularism emphasized a modern, scientific outlook and strict separation of
  • religion from politics, promoting equal state distance from all faith-Gandhian secularism
  • valued moral and spiritual unity, viewing all religions as paths to truth and emphasizing
  • tolerance, harmony, and mutual respect rather than separation.
questions.final_answer: tolerance, harmony, and mutual respect rather than separation

questions.question: Identify the role of personal laws in preserving religious and cultural identity.
questions.solution_html:
• Personal laws preserve religious and cultural identity by allowing communities to follow
  • their own traditions in matters like marriage, inheritance, and family- protect diversity and
  • autonomy but also face criticism for perpetuating inequality, especially concerning gender
  • rights and uniformity in national legal frameworks.
questions.final_answer: rights and uniformity in national legal frameworks

questions.question: Explain regional political parties play a vital role preserving linguistic identity in India?
questions.solution_html:
• Regional political parties safeguard linguistic identity by promoting regional languages
  • culture, and interests within federal politics- advocate for language-based education, local
  • autonomy, and equitable resource distribution, ensuring that India’s linguistic diversity is
  • respected and represented in governance and policy decisions.
questions.final_answer: respected and represented in governance and policy decisions

questions.question: Debate whether the abrogation of Article 370 in 2019 resolved or deepened the Kashmir problem
questions.solution_html:
• Abrogation of Article 370 in 2019 aimed to integrate Jammu and Kashmir fully into India
  • promoting uniform laws and governance-supporters see it as national consolidation, while
  • critics argue it deepened alienation, reduced autonomy, and heightened political and social
  • tensions in the region.
questions.final_answer: tensions in the region
